summary: Visteon Corporation filed an 8-K regarding Amendment No. 8 to its existing credit agreement, refinancing its revolving and term loan facilities with $400M in new revolver and $300M in term loans, replacing the administrative agent and increasing covenant flexibility. The new loans carry margins of 1.00%-1.75% (SOFR) or 0.00%-0.75% (Base Rate) with a commitment fee of 0.15%-0.25% on unused amounts. This is a routine refinancing of existing debt facilities, not a special situation. No equity, acquisition, divestiture, activism, or restructuring event is present. Ordinary course credit agreement amendment, no special-situation impact.
